    "# Tutorial 3: Horizontal denoising and integration on Mouse Brain dataset from 10x Visium "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "4bc1d489-11a2-4272-b680-1ce19181e068",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "In this tutorial, to assess STADIM’s ability to resolve fine anatomical structures, we analyze horizontally adjacent mouse whole-brain slices generated by the 10x Visium platform.   \n",
    "We download the data via:  \n",
    "Anterior: https://www.10xgenomics.com/datasets/mouse-brain-serial-section-1-sagittal-anterior-1-standard-1-1-0  \n",
    "Posterior: https://www.10xgenomics.com/datasets/mouse-brain-serial-section-1-sagittal-posterior-1-standard-1-1-0"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "4dd39920-f7d0-4770-bde8-8f8a4a0eca22",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Quick view data"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "b6404621-faae-41ab-9e01-dadc6466115d",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "MBSS1SA\n",
      "AnnData object with n_obs × n_vars = 2695 × 32285\n",
      "    obs: 'in_tissue', 'array_row', 'array_col', 'sample'\n",
      "    var: 'gene_ids', 'feature_types', 'genome'\n",
      "    uns: 'spatial'\n",
      "    obsm: 'spatial'\n",
      "MBSS1SP\n",

   "source": [
    "import anndata as ad\n",
    "import os\n",
    "\n",
    "sample_ids = ['MBSS1SA', 'MBSS1SP']\n",
    "data_dir = '/data2/xiaost/SODA/Data/MB/'\n",
    "\n",
    "for i, s_id in enumerate(sample_ids):\n",
    "    adata = ad.read_h5ad(os.path.join(data_dir, f'{s_id}.h5ad'))\n",
    "    print(f'{s_id}')\n",
    "    print(adata)"
   ]

    "## Run STADIM"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "cc2cb45b-996c-436b-9f66-7bc5a343fa14",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "You can call the STADIM command directly in your terminal:\n",
    "```bash\n",
    "nohup stadim --input \"./MBSS1SA.h5ad\" \"./MBSS1SP.h5ad\" --save_dir ./MB_test --device \"cuda:0\" --monitor --seed 2026 --min_genes 0 --min_cells 10 --knn_c 6 --knn_e 10 --mnn_n 25 > ./MB_test.log 2>&1 &\n",
    "```\n",
    "and load the results into your Python environment for downstream analysis. The denoised expression matrix is conveniently stored within the `layers` attribute:\n",
    "```python\n",
    "import anndata as ad\n",
    "\n",
    "adata = ad.read_h5ad('/MB_test/sdata.h5ad')\n",
    "\n",
    "## The denoised gene expressionis is stored in adata.layers['STADIM']\n",
    "print(adata)\n",
    "```\n",
    "or you can call STADIM within a Jupyter Notebook as follows:"
   ]
  },

    "                          save_preprocessed_h5ad=None, save_dir=None, \n",
    "                          sample_names=None, batch_key='sample', device='cuda:4', seed=2026, \n",

    "                          batch_size=256, triplets_update_ratio=0.8, hard_triplets_ratio=0.7,\n",
    "                          epochs=100, lr=1e-3, loss_mode='nb', beta_trip=0.1,\n",
    "                          encoder_layers=[512, 256, 64], decoder_layers=[1000])"
   ]

    "## Analysis"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "d545897e-eacd-4e2e-af9c-a1df44bd86a0",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import anndata as ad\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import scanpy as sc \n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import os\n",
    "import warnings\n",
    "warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')\n",
    "\n",
    "import seaborn as sns\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "from matplotlib.lines import Line2D\n",
    "import matplotlib.patches as mpatches\n",
    "plt.rcParams.update({\n",
    "    'font.size': 16, \n",
    "    'axes.labelsize': 18,  \n",
    "    'axes.titlesize': 18,  \n",
    "    'xtick.labelsize': 16, \n",
    "    'ytick.labelsize': 16,  \n",
    "    'legend.fontsize': 16,\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "my_colors = [\n",
    "  '#c49c94', '#1f77b4', '#bcbd22', \"#BCD896\", '#9edae5', '#c7c7c7', # 0-5\n",
    "  '#c5b0d5', '#2ca02c', '#17becf', '#aec7e8', '#ff9896', '#ff7f0e', # 6-11\n",
    "  '#98df8a', '#e377c2', '#d62728', '#f7b6d3', \"#6BBE92\", '#8c564b', # 12-17\n",
    "  '#FCC616', \"#9b2626\", '#d6616b', '#9467bd', '#dbdb8d', \"#E97F5A\", # 18-23\n",
    "  '#ffbb78', '#e7969c', '#ffff99', \"#637939\", '#a55194', '#e7969c', # 24-29\n",
    "]"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "9d0085c0-5b86-4958-9358-b553244eaeb8",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "s1, s2 = sample_ids[0], sample_ids[1]\n",
    "\n",
    "new_spatial = adata.obsm['spatial'].copy().astype(float)\n",
    "\n",
    "mask1 = adata.obs['sample'] == s1\n",
    "coords1 = new_spatial[mask1]\n",
    "width1 = coords1[:, 0].max() - coords1[:, 0].min()\n",
    "new_spatial[mask1] -= [coords1[:, 0].min(), coords1[:, 1].min()]\n",
    "\n",
    "mask2 = adata.obs['sample'] == s2\n",
    "coords2 = new_spatial[mask2]\n",
    "gap = 1 \n",
    "new_spatial[mask2] -= [coords2[:, 0].min(), coords2[:, 1].min()]\n",
    "new_spatial[mask2] += [width1 + gap, 0]\n",
    "\n",
    "adata.obsm['spatial_joined'] = new_spatial"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "fbeb15fd-dd57-42e1-b1a3-f2f95407968e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Louvain"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "2ae7361c-44f4-4d66-9039-ac8c1063bc95",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The following package needs to be installed in the environment:\n",
    "```bash\n",
    "pip install louvain python-igraph\n",
    "```"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "2d530bac-29ef-42bd-9b04-dbdce7d663be",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1000x800 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "method = 'STADIM'\n",
    "cluster_key = f\"{method}_clusters\"\n",
    "sc.pp.neighbors(adata, use_rep=method, key_added=method)\n",
    "sc.tl.louvain(adata, neighbors_key=method, key_added=cluster_key, resolution=0.8)\n",
    "n_clusters = len(adata.obs[cluster_key].unique())\n",
    "\n",
    "# if n_clusters==nnn:\n",
    "adata.uns[f\"{cluster_key}_colors\"] = my_colors[:n_clusters]\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))\n",
    "sc.pl.spatial(adata, color=cluster_key, spot_size=150, title=None, show=False, ax=ax, alpha_img=0.5, library_id=None,basis='spatial_joined')\n",
    "ax.set_title(f\"#Mouse Brain - STADIM\", fontsize=36, pad=10)#fontweight='bold', \n",
    "ax.set_xlabel(\"\")\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel(\"\")\n",
    "ax.set_aspect('equal')\n",
    "ax.axis('off')\n",
    "\n",
    "handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()\n",
    "ax.legend(handles, labels, title=\"Clusters\", title_fontsize=20, fontsize=18, handletextpad=0.1,\n",
    "          ncol=2, loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(0.98, 1.2), labelspacing=0.2, columnspacing=0.2, markerscale=2, frameon=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
